description: Warranty disclaimer: company expects standard warranties; vendor disclaims ALL warranties including the implied warranty of merchantability. Warranty is HIGH-tier per rubric — the test is whether the agent recognizes that 'AS IS' disclaimers stay HIGH (or even tilt CRITICAL given the breadth) and don't get downgraded.

company_clauses.text: Vendor warrants to Customer that the Services shall: (a) be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner in accordance with industry standards; (b) conform in all material respects to the specifications set forth in the applicable Statement of Work; and (c) not infringe any third-party intellectual property rights. Customer's sole remedy for breach of warranty (a) or (b) shall be Vendor's re-performance of the affected Services at no additional charge.

vendor_clauses.text: THE SERVICES ARE PROVIDED 'AS IS' AND 'AS AVAILABLE' WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EITHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION ANY IMPLIED WARRANTY OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, TITLE, OR NON-INFRINGEMENT. VENDOR DOES NOT WARRANT THAT THE SERVICES WILL BE UNINTERRUPTED, ERROR-FREE, OR SECURE. CUSTOMER ASSUMES THE ENTIRE RISK AS TO THE QUALITY AND PERFORMANCE OF THE SERVICES.

expected_conflicts.topic: Warranty disclaimer — AS IS vs express warranties
expected_conflicts.notes: Warranty is HIGH per rubric §2. Vendor's clause also disclaims non-infringement, which interacts with IP / indemnification (CRITICAL topics) — making CRITICAL also defensible if the agent reasons through the cross-topic implication. The wrong answers are MEDIUM (downgrade) or LOW (severe downgrade). Strict warranty-tier-only is HIGH; cross-topic-aware is CRITICAL.

rubric_notes: Tests whether the agent holds the HIGH tier on a warranty disclaimer, with explicit accommodation for CRITICAL when the agent reasons that the non-infringement disclaimer interacts with indemnification/IP CRITICAL topics. acceptable_risks=[HIGH, CRITICAL] — both are senior moves. MEDIUM or LOW are tier-misses.
